notes.title: 2024 Major Update
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to the latest update of Toast the Ghost![/b]

Over a year in the making, here's an overview of what's been added:

[b]Character customisation[/b]
Be who you want to be. Comes with a choice of skin tones, lets you mix body, head, and hair types.  Character selection saved for future plays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43013901/14b62c5e3a2c54ab661acf7e1db212682d0da3ac.jpg[/img]

[b]Graphical improvements[/b]
A ton of changes have been made here, most notably:

[list]
[*]Improved level backgrounds and parallax scrolling
[*]Ghost effects and animations improved
[*]Title screen improvements
[*]New toaster effects
[*]Coloured Ghosts now look in your direction at all times
[*]On collection, Coloured Ghosts now show their love for you 
[*]Player avatar matches your custom character
[*]Vines and greenery added throughout the rounds
[*]Health loss is shown when Player or White Ghosts are hit
[*]New Medal Graphics and all Steam Achievements updated
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43013901/dc6f47be9e1e487cbe94a9d4fc17aaf564c942b3.jpg[/img]


[b]Gameplay improvements[/b]
Black and Red Label modes have a completely new scoring mechanism!  Coins collected add to a score multiplier, enabling you to clock massive scores of over 1 million even on Round 1!  Be aware however, getting hurt will reset the multiplier back to 0.

Lots of annoying bugs fixed

End of Game BOSS added!  The Temple of Boo is guarded by the Aztec God Xolotl, the god of lightning, death, and fire.  Can you defeat it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43013901/0e219596c9fec7435b5c2a13883783158d17f85e.jpg[/img]

[b]General improvements[/b]
Improved "How to play" section.  It was too wordy, and the font was hard to read.  This has all been simplified and makes much more sense!

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
This small patch aims to fix a rare bug where your character can become completely stuck (refuses to move).  Time will tell!

Also prevented the Jump sound effect playing if you press Jump while shooting your toast :)

Have fun!
